data.title: Iran attacks US targets despite Trump threats
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran attacked US military bases in Kuwait on Thursday, despite President Donald Trump threatening further strikes in a fresh flare-up six months into the war.

data.title: Far-right AfD eyes huge win in east German state vote
data.description: BERLIN - Germany faces a landmark regional election Sunday in the ex-communist east where the far-right AfD is easily expected to win and has its sights on heading its first state government.

data.title: Bangkok data centre cited for unlawful fuel storage
data.description: About 200,000 litres of fuel stockpiled without permission have been removed from a data centre on Rama IX Road in Bangkok, with authorities saying they will pursue charges under Fuel Control Act.

data.title: EU eyes Russia sanctions after drone ‘attack’ in Germany
data.description: WICKLOW, Ireland - The European Union (EU) on Wednesday said it had summoned Russia’s top diplomat as it eyed sanctions after a drone incident in Germany that the bloc’s foreign policy chief said bore the marks of “state-sponsored terrorism”.

data.title: Thailand expands stroke networks to cut critical treatment delays
data.description: Stroke treatment in Thailand still faces delays and regional gaps, while mobile units, AI and tele-stroke networks offer ways to speed up care.

data.title: Nepal seeks climate justice after Himalayan disaster
data.description: KATHMANDU - When a wall of icy debris from a glacial collapse on the China-Nepal border tore through his village last week, Pemba Chhring Tamang watched the landscape he had known all his life disappear.

data.title: Defence chiefs back bigger US military presence in Australia
data.description: SYDNEY - Washington and Canberra have agreed to boost the US military presence in Australia and speed up cooperation, both countries said on Thursday.

data.title: Thailand’s ‘Jurassic Park’ shines light on dinosaur evolution
data.description: KHON KAEN - A dinosaur statue stands guard outside a temple, a hint at the ancient giants buried deep in the earth below making up northeastern Thailand’s “dinosaur rush”.

data.title: ONE Championship: Stamp Fairtex plans MMA return after Selina Flores – but wants ‘one or two’ fights before title shot
data.description: Stamp Fairtex plans to return to MMA after Saturday’s ONE Fight Night 47 main event against Selina Flores – but does not expect to challenge immediately for the promotion’s vacant atomweight title.

data.title: Hamilton aiming for record sixth Italian GP triumph
data.description: MONZA, Monza - Lewis Hamilton will seek to boost his hopes of an unprecedented eighth drivers’ world championship with a record sixth Italian Grand Prix win on Sunday when he races on Ferrari’s home tarmac.

data.title: US not ‘stealing Venezuelan oil’, energy secretary insists
data.description: CARACAS - US Energy Secretary Chris Wright on Wednesday dismissed claims that Washington was “stealing Venezuelan oil” after the South American nation granted its northern neighbour access to a huge chunk of its natural resources.

data.title: Pacific states debate response to Chinese missile test
data.description: KOROR, Palau - The president of Palau called on Thursday for a “unified” Pacific response to July’s missile test by China on the final day of a summit clouded by allegations of meddling by Beijing.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Sept 3
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: George Lucas unveils art galaxy at his new LA museum
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - George Lucas, the legendary creator of the "Star Wars" saga, on Wednesday showcased his long-awaited Museum of Narrative Art, the culmination of nearly two decades of work and numerous obstacles.

data.title: Purin Film Fund opens applications  for sixth edition of Short Film Camp
data.description: <p>The Purin Film Fund is now accepting applications for a 10-day workshop for filmmakers from Myanmar, Thailand, Laos and Cambodia until Sept 25.</p>

data.title: 1,520 electric buses set for rollout
data.description: The Bangkok Mass Transit Authority (BMTA) is preparing 1,520 electric buses to replace ageing vehicles, with deliveries expected to begin in March 2027.

data.title: 151 arrested in e-cigarette blitz
data.description: Cyber police arrested 151 suspects and seized more than 140 million baht over the past year in a crackdown on illegal e-cigarette networks.

data.title: Police seize fake memory cards
data.description: PATHUM THANI: Police have seized 16,245 counterfeit memory cards after complaints that fake products sold online caused severe damage to customers' data and computer systems.

data.title: US Open under the influence: content creators spark debate
data.description: NEW YORK - Jessica Pegula is all in favor of bringing more fans into tennis, but the world number three said Wednesday it's important to keep the focus on the game.

data.title: Sabalenka storms into US Open third round as Pegula, Medvedev advance
data.description: NEW YORK - Aryna Sabalenka took the next step on the road to a rare US Open three-peat, routing qualifier Polina Iatcenko 6-1, 6-1 to join a raft of contenders cruising into the third round on Wednesday.
